label: UK brokerage account (Section 104)
En aktieklass i en verifierad Section 10: One share class in a verified Section 104 pool. Proportional withdrawals may use the pool average only when no purchases on the same day or within 30 days after sale require different matching, including in external accounts. Confirm this for the whole projection. Additional contributions and reinvested dividends are disabled; dividends go to cash. Immediate repurchases and other matching profiles are unsupported.
En daterad homogen post. Blandade anskaf: One dated homogeneous lot. Mixed acquisitions must be held in separate accounts.
Verifierad Section 104-pool utan köp sam: Verified Section 104 pool with no purchases on the same day or 30 days after sale
Om verkliga eller planerade affärer bryt: Do not use this account profile if actual or planned transactions violate the condition.
Bekräfta Section 104-villkor och frånvar: Confirm the Section 104 conditions and the absence of matching purchases.
